description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
vibe: One file to rule them all — read the guide or don't bother.
highlights: Single mandatory entry point: AGENT_GUIDE.md must be read before any response
Explicit prohibition on acting before reading the guide
Zero instructions in the rules file itself — pure indirection
Warning that skipping the guide causes wrong actions
Routing rules centralized in one external document
assessment: This is a radical anti-slop move: the rules file contains no rules, only a hard gate to a single source of truth. It eliminates drift between multiple instruction files and forces a deterministic first action, which is exactly what a 700+ skill agentic system needs to avoid chaotic behavior.
